grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple: aubergines, mackerel, runner beans, Greek yoghurt, bread, oil and spices.

supermarket.reason: Fresh mackerel fillets, aubergines and runner beans are everyday July items in Tesco and similar supermarkets.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a saucepan and a frying pan, and the techniques are simple roasting, mashing, boiling and pan-frying.

works.reason: Two roasted aubergines mashed with yoghurt make enough spread for four slices, and the mackerel and bean timings are sound; toasting the bread is a detail any cook will fill in.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes of active work covers slicing the beans, mashing, frying the fish and toasting, and the 35-minute cook time matches the aubergine roast.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including lemon, mint and smoked paprika (called just 'paprika' in step 3), is used, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: It is a light, warm summer lunch for July, and the soft roasted aubergine spread forms the base of every slice rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short and clear, in plain British English, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, vegetables and yoghurt on crusty toast make a satisfying, balanced lunch a family would happily eat again.
